This is a proof draft relative to the task's exact actual-ample G0, not independent certification of that grant or a complete solution of original P16.5.

Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero and arbitrary cardinality; X smooth integral projective, dimension n≥1; q:X→Y projective birational with Y integral normal projective; A actual ample rational; and actual L≃q*A. Use the literal numerical cone defined by one all-point decreasing FS net in actual varying bundles B_i with c1(B_i)→c1(L), rather than defining a pullback cone. Reference0 is the actual canonical metric.

Every defining numerical net embeds on a tail in one actual ample bundle M: multiply sections by generators of M−B_i. The generating canonical scalar is identically zero, so the scalar is preserved exactly, including poles. Ample all-point divisorial determination consequently applies.

Use the blowup-ideal construction retained in the supplied BJ v4 Theorem4.32 proof. Write q as the blowup of a generically trivial ideal b, with exceptional Cartier E, and choose actual ample H on Y with H⊗b generated and q*H−E ample. Let beta=log|b|, so q*beta=log||s_E|| and beta(v0)=0. Normal proper birational descent gives q_*O_X=O_Y: regular upstairs functions have no codimension-one poles on the normal base, by proper valuative lifting and the normal-ring intersection characterization. Thus H0(X,mq*B)=H0(Y,mB) for actual bundles B.

For fixed rational epsilon>0, a tail of the defining u_i embeds in actual q*(A+epsilon H)−epsilon E. Multiply by s_epsilonE and descend the actual sections. Their downstairs net decreases and its actual ample endpoint phi_epsilon satisfies q*phi_epsilon=u+epsilon q*beta everywhere. No infinite values are subtracted. Normalize (phi_epsilon−u(v0))/(1+eta) into the actual A cone using eta A−epsilon H ample. As eta,epsilon→0, its finite divisorial coordinates converge to those of u−u(v0) in the common function field. Ample compactness supplies an actual A-psh endpoint. Pullback and common-ample all-point determination give u=q*psi everywhere. Hence q*PSH(Y,A)=PSH(X,L) for the entire genuine cone, with order and divisorial homeomorphism. This avoids general BJ4.6 flattening, whose abstract statement fails at common poles.

All fixed-L sections descend, and G0 supplies decreasing fixed-L continuous FS approximants. At finite rational metric stages, use actual nef model intersections on a common normal graph model. The coefficient is b_F(L_1⋯L_n.[F]), where b_F=ord_F(t) and v_F=b_F^−1 ord_F restricted to k(X). Components mapping to smaller dimension have zero pulled n-fold degree. Over a downstairs central component, degree-one birational projection is an isomorphism at its generic DVR. Fundamental central cycles and every b_F are retained. Thus actual upstairs products push to actual downstairs products before limits. Compactified intersection projection also gives finite-stage energy equality. BE regularization and continuous product compatibility handle real coefficients.

Choose nowhere-dense Z where q is not an isomorphism and F=q^−1Z, referring to analytic support rather than valuation centers. Ample finite-energy mixed measures and targets give Z^an zero mass. An explicit proof uses a section potential a vanishing on Z, the capacity estimate Cap{a≤−t}≤n/t from ample integration by parts, and J(c)≤1+∫_1^∞t^n Cap{c≤−t}dt for c=1−(1−a)^alpha, 0<alpha<1/(n+1). This constructs a genuine finite-energy pole test and forces zero mass by G0 integrability.

Positive finite-stage products have fixed mass V=A^n. On compact X^an every subnet has a weakly convergent further subnet. Each cluster has the prescribed downstairs pushforward and therefore zero F mass. Off F,Z the analytic map is a homeomorphism, so the cluster is unique. The whole arbitrary net converges independently of approximation. The Radon lift characterizes these limits of actual products; it does not define finite-stage products.

Local compatibility is separately proved. Two independently supplied bounded generated FS/contact nets with the same endpoint use one actual ample collar v=h0+p. With suitable R,M, glue Phi=p+R^−1 max(w−(Rv+M+1),0). G0's scoped contact bridge makes Phi actual ample psh. On the inner chart w=R Phi+R h0+M+1, retaining the essential reference term. The two nets have the same explicit global endpoint, hence identical local product limits. Actual unit-log frame changes give equal finite products, and compact tests pass equality to limits. This includes neighborhoods meeting F and is confined to the stated generated category.

Define original energy by actual mixed products and reference0, then by floors max(u,−k). It equals E_A(psi), so the actual floor space E1(X,L) equals q*E1(Y,A). The genuine winning-set floor operator agrees with the finite-stage limit. Its raw mass V=L^n=A^n equals vol(L), by actual section equality and ample Hilbert asymptotics. Mixed floors agree. For arbitrary decreasing finite-energy tests and products, normalize tests below C. Positive weighted measures (C−u_0i)mu_i have downstairs G0 integrable weighted limits and convergent masses; compact uniqueness gives upstairs weighted convergence. Subtract Cmu_i and handle test differences separately. No arbitrary-Borel-net monotone convergence is assumed.

The intrinsic original targets are positive Radon mu with mass V and finite D_L(mu)=sup_{u∈E1}(E_L(u)−∫u dmu). Whole-cone and energy equality give D_L(mu)=D_A(q_*mu), so zero F mass follows intrinsically. G0 attains the downstairs equation; its actual pullback attains the original objective and solves the already constructed operator. Comparison and domination transfer through actual pulled strict sets and order. Equal measures force actual all-point potentials to differ by one constant.

For every original continuous f, fiber minima are lsc and maxima usc. Off Z they agree. Clipped continuous minorants and majorants bound the envelope-energy difference quotients; negative t reverses both obstacle ordering and division. Radon inner regularity supplies compact K off Z with small complement. Monotone continuous approximants converge uniformly on K by compact Dini for arbitrary nets; the complement error is bounded by 2||f|| times its mass. Squeezing proves both outer derivatives equal ∫f MA_L(u), including directions that do not descend on exceptional fibers.

The complete proof is in P16.5-argument.md and standalone P16.5-paper.tex; the PDF is build/P16.5-paper.pdf. Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero and arbitrary cardinality. Let X=P1×P1, Y=P1, q=p1, r=p2, actual L=q*O(1), H=r*O(1), references0. Here L²=0, L.H=1 and h0(X,mL)=m+1, so top volume is0.

G0's explicit all-point fiber theorem applies because q is projective with geometrically connected fibers and its base bundle is actual ample. Every genuine numerical L-potential is constant on every analytic fiber, including −infinity. Pull its one defining varying-class FS net along the actual section s0 with second coordinate0, omitting sections restricting to zero. The endpoint remains generically finite because s0(v0) and the generic trivial point of X lie in the same analytic fiber. Thus the pulled net genuinely defines a base O(1)-potential. Fiber constancy gives all-point equality; converse ample section pullback is genuine. Consequently the entire initially defined cone is q*PSH(Y,O(1)), with commuting references and floors.

At finite actual metric stages define M(u)=T_(L,u) wedge T_(H,0). Multiply a base metric test configuration by the second P1. Every central E×P1 retains b_E=ord_E(t), and its mixed degree is the base metric degree times deg O(1)=1. Its normalized valuation extends the base by the Gauss rule |sum a_jw^j|=max_j|a_j|. Hence actual model products give M(q*psi)=sigma_*MA_A(psi). The polynomial maximum formula proves continuity of sigma, including projective overlaps; its graph is compact closed. This precedes target selection. Ample decreasing regularization, bounded local compatibility from n1 and continuous sigma give independent mixed limits, floors and weighted convergence.

The named degree-one energy relative to the extra datum (H,0) is E_L,H(u)=1/2∫u[M(u)+M(0)]. Finite intersection projection, bounded weighted limits and then floors give E_L,H(q*psi)=E_A(psi), with entire lower-degree floor space q*E1(A). Constants shift energy by c. This is not normalization of L²=0.

Let x0=s0(v0), mu=delta_x0. Its mixed mass is1. Every genuine test u=q*psi integrates to psi(v0)=sup psi. Raw ample energy is at most this supremum, with equality for constants. Therefore D_L,H(mu)=sup(E_L,H(u)−∫u dmu)=0. Nevertheless mu is not an output: x0 kills w, whereas every Gauss seminorm has |w|=1, and all actual outputs are supported on the closed Gauss graph. In particular M(0)=delta_generic-trivial-X differs from delta_x0, although their pushforwards, every genuine L-test integral and dual energies agree. An auxiliary-ample polar condition is not already in this target condition.

Set f0(w)=max(0,min(1,−log|w|)), extended1 at0 and0 at infinity, and f=r*f0. It is continuous because it is constant near both endpoints. Every analytic q-fiber has minimum0 and maximum1, attained by the actual infinity and zero sections over its completed residue field. A genuine competitor below tf is fiber constant. For t>0 it is at most0 everywhere, attained by0; for t<0 it is at most t, attained by constant t. Thus P_L(tf)=0 for t≥0 and t for t<0, and E_L,H(P_L(tf))=min(0,t). The right derivative is0 and left derivative1. The actual M(0) integrates f to0, agreeing only with the positive sign. These are continuous obstacles, so this is the outer energy itself.

This disproves the recipe comprising the whole L-cone, this mixed operator, mass1, finite intrinsic dual energy and both original continuous outer signs. Its exact image is the Gauss lift of ample finite-energy targets on Y. Alternative theories may retain justified fiber/carrier data, restrict exact targets or change directions; no universal impossibility follows.

Retain the field and original-X hypotheses of n1, and any actual nef rational L, without semiampleness, finite generation, countability, toric, skeletal or support restrictions. For actual ample H, the entire literal cone satisfies PSH(X,L)=intersection_{epsilon∈Q>0}PSH(X,L+epsilon H). Forward inclusion embeds a defining FS net by generators of ample differences. Conversely take G0 finite continuous fixed-(L+epsilon H) approximants f_epsilon,j↓u and shift by positive delta. Order triples by decreasing epsilon,delta and scalar. Given two old shifted functions, their minimum b is finite continuous. Choose smaller epsilon3 and delta3; u+delta3<b everywhere. For bounded genuine u_i on actual nef L_i, choose actual ample H_i and M_i=L_i+H_i. In the actual tensor metric identity L_i=M_i−H_i, expand wedge_i(T_(M_i,u_i)−T_(H_i,0)). The actual ample products on L_i+epsilon H_i are the same finite polynomial with coefficient −(1−epsilon) on H_i. Their positive weak limit is the bounded L_i product, of raw mass (L_1⋯L_n). Thus this is an actual metric construction before limits, not an arbitrary inverse Radon measure.

Define bounded energy E_L(u)=1/(n+1) sum_{j=0}^n∫u T_(L,u)^j T_(L,0)^(n−j). Genuine ample polynomial perturbations prove monotonicity, concavity, E_L(0)=0 and translation slope V=L^n. Define E_L(u)=lim_k E_L(max(u,−k)) and actual E1_L={u∈PSH(L):E_L(u)>−infinity}. Decreasing energy continuity holds at every generically finite decreasing endpoint: fixed-k floor products and bounded weighted energies converge; E_L(u_i)≥E_L(u) and E_L(u_i)≤E_L(max(u_i,−k)); pass the original net and then k→infinity. This gives concavity and bounded-reference floor compatibility. These are actual original functions, not completion elements.

For u≤0, put u_k=max(u,−k), mu_k=MA_L(u_k). Borel bounded locality makes 1_{u>−k}mu_k increase. Their mass-bounded limit is Radon by compact inner approximation and finite-mass complements, and defines the genuine reference nonpluripolar original operator. Different bounded references compare on common winning sets. If u∈E1_L and C=−E_L(u)<infinity, positivity in the energy sum gives ∫(−u_k)dmu_k≤(n+1)C and mu_k{u≤−k}≤(n+1)C/k. Consequently the endpoint operator has full raw mass L^n, charges no poles of u, and satisfies ∫(−u)MA_L(u)≤(n+1)C. No unsupplied nef-volume asymptotic proof is used to discharge further analytic gates outside n1's semiample domain.

The endpoint measure and mu_k agree on {u>−k} and have equal full mass. Their total-variation distance is at most 2(n+1)C/k. For a decreasing E1 net with E1 endpoint, normalize a tail below a common upper constant. Monotonicity bounds its negative energies uniformly. At fixed k, bounded products converge; first choose k, then the original index. This proves actual arbitrary decreasing-net weak continuity. Locality passes through floor exhaustions. For w=max(u,v), full mass gives MA(v){u<v}≤MA(u){u≤v}. Apply to v−delta and let delta↓0 through a sequence to obtain genuine finite-energy comparison. Comparison does not establish domination or uniqueness.

For actual numerically trivial L, defining normalized FS functions embed after scaling in epsilon times an ample cone. Compact divisorial evaluation bounds force every endpoint to be constant everywhere by ample determination. Constants genuinely arise from L+epsilon A generating systems. The actual canonical metric is the tensor quotient of ample canonical A+L and A; genuine signed products cancel to zero. Energy is0, the sole positive mass-zero target is0, and actual constant solutions are unique modulo constants with zero outer derivatives.
